run_oneshot_quantization: run oneshot quantization on a GLM-4.7 MoE model using AWQModifier with W4A16 scheme
create_awq_modifier_recipe: create an AWQModifier recipe targeting Linear layers with W4A16 quantization scheme and ignore patterns
preprocess_chat_dataset: preprocess a chat dataset by applying a tokenizer chat template to convert messages to text
tokenize_calibration_dataset: tokenize a calibration dataset with max sequence length truncation and no padding
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed format
